composition.serve_who: This sheet ("PORT PEDESTAL INTERCONNECTIONS", GMMS 108'-123) documents the port helm pedestal's switch/illumination console and its multi-core cable connections (MU-A..MU-F, MU-12) out of the "PORT J/BOX 1 (LASARETTE)" junction box to: the joystick cluster (main sheet/traveler/bow/stern thruster), throttle potentiometers (propulsion/regeneration/enable), and a large bank of sailing-function pushbuttons with paired red LED indicators (VANG, CUNNINGHAM, OUTHAUL, DEFLECTOR, BACKSTAY, STAYSAIL, JIB, CODE 0, plus alarm/crew-call/MOB/dimmer functions). It also carries the AFT MYT PLC BOX terminal strip (DI/DO/AI channel wiring) and LVPDU/XC23 supply connector wiring feeding the pedestal. Evidence: sheet title, the dotted PORT J/BOX 1 enclosure, the switch bank column labelled with each sailing function name, and the joystick/thruster cluster explicitly labelled MAIN SHEET / TRAVELER / BOW THRUSTER / STERN THRUSTER.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Joystick cluster explicitly labels a potentiometer 'BOW THRUSTER' with its own dotted symbol box, wired via terminals 7/8 to the switch-bank RED LED loom (net near CUNNINGHAM_IN/JIB_FURL_OUT). This is the command potentiometer for the bow thruster, matching the register's bow thruster node.

joystick moved -> pot wiper -> terminal 8 (blue) signal, terminal 7 (-ve) return -> onward wiring (feed side to proportional valve not traced on this sheet; see hydraulic block cross-reference)

functions.dry_data: Actuation: proportional, PVEU 0-10V (per hydraulic block record); this sheet only shows the local pot/terminal wiring, not the valve.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Joystick cluster explicitly labels a potentiometer 'STERN THRUSTER' wired via terminals 8/9 into the switch-bank loom (near OUTHAUL_IN/JIB_TACK_DOWN), matching the register's stern thruster node.

infrastructure.system_name: AFT MYT PLC BOX / Port Pedestal Terminal Strip (69-way, DI/DO/AI channels)
facts: 69-terminal numbered strip carrying AFT MYT PLC DI-01/DI-02/AI-02/AI-03/DO-01 channel wiring plus +5V, +24V AFT MYT PLC, PLC NEG, COM NEG, MYT NEG rails
Feeds/receives all pedestal switch and LED functions listed above via its numbered terminals (1-69)
Cross-connects to PLUG C (Main Panel) pins 8-11 for terminals 1-4, per 'see DWG 112/114a'
This is shared bus/rack infrastructure, not itself an equipment function
C1 pins 6/1 fed from CBx.13 5A breaker via LVPDU, labelled G3-f1P1/G3-f1R1
C2 pins 12/2/1/7/3/6 labelled G3-f12T/R/S/W/U/V — likely twisted-pair signal wiring crossing to THROTTLE FWD/REVERSE potentiometer terminals (BLK/WHT/+red) per drawn crossover lines

uncertainties: Positive/feed side of the PROPULSION, REGENERATION, and ENABLE indicator lamps (Re1/Re2/Re4/T relay group) is not fully traced — only the switch/terminal-to-lamp return side is drawn; which upstream rail (XC23 C3 or LVPDU) actually supplies these coils is ambiguous.
Positive/feed side of LED DIM1/DIM2/DIM3 dimmer modules (button dimmer, back lighting, down lights functions) is not traced — only ground/return and relay contact wiring is drawn.

The Re4/T relay pair driving the 'CALL MODULE' output has neither coil's full feed+return path traced; direction of control (does Re4 energise T, or vice versa) is not fully clear from the drawn lines.

The 'Pedestal Alarm + Mute' 4-terminal buzzer/lamp/pushbutton block near the title has no traced positive supply — its relationship to the main switch-bank ALARM MUTE/AUDIO MUTE functions (same device repeated, or a separate physical unit) is not established by drawn lines.

No equipment-register node exists specifically for a 'pedestal console utility' (button dimmer/back lighting/down lights/mute/crew-call/MOB/call-module) group; these were placed on 652-onyx-monitoring as the closest monitoring/annunciation fit — engineer should confirm whether a dedicated console/annunciator node should be created instead.
